description: Read-only JSON-RPC pass-through for 20+ EVM chains (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, gnosis, linea, scroll, zksync, mantle, blast, celo, fantom, sonic, unichain, opbnb, zora, mode, metis, cronos). Single or batch calls (up to 10). Write methods refused. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

batch.description: Optional batch of up to 10 { method, params } calls

chain.description: Target EVM chain name (e.g. ethereum, base, arbitrum)
